# India Pincode Directory (digipincode)

Free directory of every pincode, village, panchayat and district in India — 6 lakh places with LGD codes, census data and DIGIPIN. Independent site, not an official India Post website.

## Key pages

- [Home — India Pincode Directory](https://digipincode.pages.dev/): search 6 lakh villages, panchayats & pincodes; browse states → districts → tehsils → villages → pincodes.
- [DIGIPIN — India Post Digital Address Code](https://digipincode.pages.dev/digipin/): what DIGIPIN is (10-character official digital address code, ~3.8 m precision), how to find your DIGIPIN, decode any DIGIPIN code to its location, DIGIPIN vs PIN code difference, format (XXX-YYY-ZZZZ), and uses for delivery, emergency services, KYC and logistics. Runs India Post's official open-source algorithm entirely in the browser.

## About

All data is collected from government records (Census 2011, District Census Handbooks, India Post). Where a value is not collected yet, the site says so explicitly — no guessed data.

## Contact

- Report an issue: use the "Report an Issue" button on any pincode page.
